fields.label: Profile Name
fields.description: For example: Park View, from their billing software.

fields.label: Source System
fields.description: The application the data comes from, for example SAP IS-U.

fields.label: Dates in the File
fields.options:
Day first (31-12-2026)
Month first (12/31/2026)
Year first (2026-12-31)

fields.label: Default Utility
fields.description: Used where the file has no utility column.

fields.label: Default Category
fields.description: Used where the file has no category column.

fields.label: House Numbers
fields.description: How the source writes a house number, as a pattern with named parts: house, and optionally block and sector.

fields.label: House Number Pattern
fields.description: Examples: (?P<house>\d+)-?(?P<block>[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*) for 59-C or 987-M3; (?P<block>[A-Z]+)\s*(?P<house>\d+) for N 2308; (?P<house>\d+)\s+(?P<block>.+) for 2413 Tulip Overseas Block. Empty: the house column is used as it is.

fields.label: Columns
fields.description: Only the columns whose names differ from our workbook's need a row. Fill SAP IS-U Columns adds SAP's standard names.

fields.label: Values
fields.description: Codes in the source that mean one of our values, for example Res → Residential.
